Endpoint to get Location Details.
Returns up to 50 AI token usage records for the selected location and page.

schema.title: Response Get Ai Usage Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Ai Usage Get

get.description: Returns campaigns for the selected location. You can browse by page and optionally filter by channel to focus on SMS, Email, or WhatsApp campaigns.

schema.title: Response Get Location Campaigns Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Campaigns Get

post.description: Creates a campaign for the selected location using a chosen template, list, and channel. You can send immediately or provide a schedule time for later delivery.

delete.description: Deletes a campaign from the selected location. Use this when a campaign should no longer appear in campaign history or planning workflows.

get.description: Returns the details of a single campaign for the selected location, including campaign name, channel, targeted list, total recipients, schedule time, and current status.

Returns a paginated list of contacts for the selected location. You can search and narrow results by first name, last name, phone number, and email. Use `name` as a quick first-name search, or `first_name` for explicit first-name filtering. Filters are partial and case-insensitive, so you can type part of a value to find matches faster.

schema.title: Response Get Location Contacts Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Contacts Get

post.description: Creates one or more contacts for the selected location. Provide a single contact object, or an array of up to 100 contacts. Each contact requires at least one contact method (phone or email).

schema.title: Response Add Location Contact Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Contacts Post

delete.description: Deletes a contact from the selected location. Returns the id of the deleted contact so you can confirm which record was removed.

get.description: Returns one contact from the selected location using its contact id. Use this endpoint when you need the full current details of a specific contact.

patch.description: Updates an existing contact in the selected location. Send only the fields you want to change, such as first name, last name, phone, or email. The response returns the contact with the latest saved information.

post.description: Creates a new employee profile for the selected location. Use this to start tracking visits, reviews, and performance for that team member.

get.description: Returns a leaderboard of employees for the selected location and date range. Use it to compare team performance by visits, reviews, or conversion rate.

delete.description: Deletes an employee profile from the selected location. Use this when a team member should no longer appear in employee lists and tracking views.

patch.description: Updates an existing employee profile for the selected location. Use this to change details like display name or aliases while keeping existing performance history.

get.description: Returns performance details for one employee over a selected date range. Includes visits, reviews, and conversion rate, with sortable metrics to focus on what matters most.

post.description: Resets the performance counters for a specific employee in the selected location. Use this when you want to restart tracking from a clean baseline for that employee.

get.description: Returns private feedback entries for the selected location. You can browse by page and optionally filter by source to focus on a specific feedback channel.

schema.title: Response Get Location Private Feedbacks Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Feedbacks Get

get.description: Returns the full details of one private feedback entry for the selected location. Use this to review the original message and current reply state.

post.description: Sends a reply to a specific private feedback entry for the selected location. Use this to follow up with the customer and resolve private feedback conversations.

get.description: Returns up to 50 review invitations for the selected location and page.

schema.title: Response Get Review Invitations Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Invites Get

post.description: Sends review invitations to the provided recipients for the selected location. Use this to request customer reviews via your invitation workflow.

schema.title: Response Send Review Request Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Invites Post

get.description: Fetches the current delivery status for a review invitation.
Returns the Google Business Profile data for a location. Required path params: business_id, location_id. Includes profile title, description, regular hours, special hours, services, and metadata.

patch.description: Updates the Google Business Profile description for a location. Required path params: business_id, location_id. Required body: description. Returns the updated profile.

get.description: Returns Google profile monthly search keywords impressions for a required month. Current month is not allowed. No comparison against previous period is included.
get.summary: Get Google Business Profile search keywords

get.description: Returns Google profile performance metrics for a required date range. Requires start_date and end_date query params. No comparison against previous period is included.
get.summary: Get Google Business Profile performance metrics

get.description: Returns regular opening hours for the location profile with stable period ids. Required path params: business_id, location_id.

post.description: Adds a regular opening-hour period to the location profile. Required path params: business_id, location_id. Required body: openDay, openTime, closeDay, closeTime.

delete.description: Removes a regular opening-hour period by period_id. Required path params: business_id, location_id, period_id. Returns the updated list of periods.

patch.description: Updates an existing regular opening-hour period by period_id. Required path params: business_id, location_id, period_id. Body fields are optional and partially updatable.

get.description: Returns Google Business Profile services for the location. Required path params: business_id, location_id. Each service includes a stable id used for update/delete operations.

post.description: Adds a free-form service to the Google profile service list. Required path params: business_id, location_id. Required body: displayName. Optional: description, languageCode, price, currencyCode.

delete.description: Removes a service from the Google profile by service_id. Required path params: business_id, location_id, service_id. Returns the updated list of services.

patch.description: Updates a service in the Google profile by service_id. Required path params: business_id, location_id, service_id. Updatable fields: description, languageCode, price, currencyCode.

get.description: Returns special opening hours for the location profile with stable period ids. Required path params: business_id, location_id.

post.description: Adds a special opening-hour period (open or closed day range). Required path params: business_id, location_id. Required body: startDate, endDate and either closed=true or open/close times.

delete.description: Removes a special opening-hour period by period_id. Required path params: business_id, location_id, period_id. Returns the updated list of periods.

patch.description: Updates a special opening-hour period by period_id. Required path params: business_id, location_id, period_id. Body fields are optional and partially updatable.

get.description: Returns reviews for the selected location. You can browse by page and optionally filter by review source to focus on specific platforms.

schema.title: Response Get Location Reviews Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Reviews Get

post.description: Publishes a reply for a specific review in the selected location. Use this to respond to customer feedback directly from your review workflow.

get.description: Returns all review and listing sites connected to the selected location. Use this to see which platforms are currently linked.

schema.title: Response Get Location Sites Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Sites Get

post.description: Connects a new review/listing site to the selected location. Use this to add platforms where you want to track reviews and presence.

delete.description: Disconnects a site from the selected location. Use this when a platform should no longer be linked or managed for that location.

get.description: Returns details for one connected site in the selected location. Use this to inspect the current setup of a specific platform.
Returns the templates available for the selected location. You can browse by page and optionally filter by channel to quickly find SMS, Email, or WhatsApp templates.

schema.title: Response Get Location Templates Business  Business Id  Location  Location Id  Templates Get

post.description: Creates a new template for the selected location. Choose the channel and provide the message content, then include channel-specific fields when needed (for example subject and sender for Email, button text for WhatsApp).

delete.description: Deletes a template from the selected location. Use this when a template is no longer needed and should be removed from the template list.

get.description: Returns the full details of a single template for the selected location, including name, channel, content, and any channel-specific fields such as sender, subject, or button text.

patch.description: Updates an existing template for the selected location. Use this endpoint to change template name, message content, and channel-specific fields for editable channels.
